newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese opposition calls general strike on Nov 28.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese opposition calls general strike on Nov 28.

text.p: Lebanese opposition groups called on Tuesday for a one-day general strike and demonstration on November 28 in protest at what they called the government's "violations of freedom and democracy".

The call was issued by a broad spectrum of opposition groups, labour unions and media workers who held a meeting in Beirut last Friday calling on Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri to change his government's priorities.
The meeting was the biggest opposition gathering since Hariri took office in October 1992.

It demanded the lifting of a three-year-old ban on public demonstrations and cancellation of a government decision to close scores of private radio and television stations and set up a follow-up committee to propose concrete action against the government.
A statement issued by the committee on Tuesday said:
"The follow-up committee for the national gathering calls on the Lebanese people to take part in a peaceful demonstration on November 28 and declares Thursday a general strike day."
